newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index ends week 1.8 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index ends week 1.8 pct higher.

text.p: Bahrain's stock exchange ended the week to Thursday 1.8 percent stronger at its highest level so far this year, official figures showed.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said the index was 32.38 points higher at 1,796.55 points from 1,764.17 points recorded a week earlier.
It said more than 14.7 million shares worth 3.2 million dinars ($8.5 million) changed hands this week, up from 10.2 million shares worth 2.47 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 27 of the 40 firms listed on the exchange were traded in 480 transactions.
The bourse said Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with 5.45 million shares worth 872,156 dinars changing hands. The share price closed 19 fils higher at 169 fils.
It said 1.99 Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait shares worth 414,959 dinars were trade in the week with the share price closing at 210 fils, up four fils from a week earlier.
Shares of Bahrain International Bank were steady at 184 fils each and Investcorp were also unchanged at $2.17 each.

The exchange said index of the commercial banking sector grew 18.37 points, banks and investment firms 77.91 points, insurance 58.04 points, the hotel and tourism sector 36.06 points, the services sector 10.27 points and the industry 9.83 points.
